description: The editor's markdown house style (docs/spec/editor.md "Markdown house style", #266): what a save writes for a note, as hand-reviewed {source, expected} pairs. `source` is read with the app's own parser; `doc` instead gives an editor-made document no file could produce (ProseMirror toJSON shape). Every case also asserts that `expected` reads back as the same document and writes itself again unchanged. TypeScript only: the serializer has no Rust consumer. Runner: src/features/editor/milkdown/markdownHouseStyle.test.ts.

cases.name: a *** rule is written ---
a ___ rule is written ---
a rule on the first line is *** (--- there would open front matter that the later rule closes)
a *** rule on the first line is written --- when no later line would close front matter
a rule on the first line stays *** when a --- line in a later code block would close front matter
a later ---- or --- x line is not a fence: the first-line rule is ---
a rule after a blank first line is not on line 1: it and the rules after it are ---
--- on line 1 closed by a later --- is front matter, blank lines in its body included
an unclosed --- on line 1 is a rule, written --- (nothing later would close front matter)
a rule as a - item's first block is ***
a rule under a tight item's paragraph is *** (--- would be a setext underline)
* and + bullets are written -
_ emphasis and __ strong are written * and **
single and double tilde strikethrough are written ~~
marks over the same text nest strikethrough outermost, then bold, then italic
an italic inside a word is written with *, which opens and closes there
two italic runs that touch are one italic run (typing Z before _b_*c*)
underscores inside words and in math are not escaped
a lone underscore needs no escape
a literal *x* keeps the one escape it needs, on the opener
asterisks that cannot be emphasis stay bare
a #tag line is not escaped
a # that would be a heading is escaped
#5 and C# are text
1. that would be a list is escaped
a heading's closing hashes are escaped only when they would close
bare URLs and www links are written bare
a scheme with nothing after it is not a link and needs no escape
an autolink is written bare
a URL that letters would extend stays an autolink
an autolink whose URL holds a backslash is bare too: the literal keeps it
a link with an empty label is written as its URL
single newlines stay single newlines
